messages:
jordan-cust: Hey team — customer reported SSO failures after they rotated IdP signing cert ~1h ago. Users see 401 on /saml/acs when authenticating.
ellen: Ok, can you paste the IdP metadata URL and any recent error from our side?
jordan-cust: https://idp.example.com/metadata — they say the metadata was updated during rotation. No other changes.
ajay: Our metadata-watcher logs show repeated fetches with `unexpected EOF while parsing` and the XML body truncated before any <KeyDescriptor>. Timestamped around the rotation.
ellen: Hmm. Any CDN in front of the IdP? CDN edge behavior can cause chunked responses.
jordan-cust: Yes they use a small CDN. They confirmed they pushed the new cert and then a cache purge.
sam: I tried to reproduce quickly. If the metadata endpoint answers with Transfer-Encoding: chunked and closes early our simple watcher can stop parsing mid-XML. Quick repro:
`# on a test host`
`printf 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

7
<Entit' | nc -l 8080`
`# in another shell`
`curl -v --fail http://localhost:8080/metadata`
Result: curl gets partial body and our watcher logs parse error.
ajay: Exactly — the real IdP was returning chunked body from the CDN, and the connection closed before the full document due to a cache flush. Our parser treated that as malformed metadata and continued using old key set, so the new certs were never picked up -> 401.
ellen: Short-term: ask customer to re-publish metadata with a Content-Length or ensure the CDN streams full body (no early connection close) while rotation completes. Also ask them to expose a versioned metadata URL if possible.
ajay: Long-term: I filed a small watcher fix to tolerate chunked streaming and retry-on-incomplete-body. Also added a config switch to require content-length for auto-rotation. PR will be linked once CI passes.
metadata-watcher-bot: watcher v2.3.1-canary deployed with incremental-chunked-retry on canary hosts at 2026-03-17T15:20Z.
jordan-cust: Customer applied CDN fix (disabled early flush) and republished metadata. They verified SSO login success after ~2m. Thanks all :tada:
ellen: Great. Can we get a short KB for support to reference when customers rotate certs behind CDNs? I'll draft one and post to #docs-support.
ajay: +1 — add the repro snippet and the watcher mitigation notes.
sam: Marking this resolved for now. Will follow up on PR and KB.
